description:
A supplier 'Legacy Corp' has gone out of business. You need to discontinue their products to stop sales. 

1. Find all products with SKU starting with 'LEG-'.
2. Update their status to 'Disabled'.
3. Change their Tax Class to 'None'.

Ensure you update ALL matching products (there are 25 total) and do NOT modify any 'CORE-' products. Use the 'Update Attributes' bulk action in the Catalog grid. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
